data.name: Usage
data.value:
washi {0} - open-source PDF toolkit (pre-alpha)
usage: washi --version washi masume detect <in.pdf> [-o out] suggest form fields -> fields.json + overlay PNGs washi masume eval <in.pdf> [-o out] score detection against the PDF's existing fields washi form make <in.pdf> [-o out.pdf] [--fields fields.json] [--lang auto|ja|zh-Hans|zh-Hant|ko|en|fr|de] make a fillable PDF (fields are detected unless --fields is given) --embed-font <font.ttf|.otf|.ttc> [--font-index n]: embed a whole font so rare characters show in every viewer (adds the font size to the file)
The interface follows your system language. Set WASHI_LANG (e.g. ja, ko, fr) to change it.

data.value: AI (Claude by default; data is shown and confirmed before it is sent): washi ai config [anthropic|openai|deepseek|local <model> [--endpoint url] [--vision yes|no]] washi ai key <anthropic|openai|deepseek> store an API key in the macOS Keychain washi ai models list the models the provider offers washi ai name-fields <in.pdf> [--fields f.json] [-o out.json] [--yes] washi ai fill <fillable.pdf> --profile me.txt [-o out.pdf] [--embed-font f] [--yes] washi ai ask <in.pdf> "question" [--yes]

data.name: UsagePdf
data.value: Pages and OCR: washi pdf merge <a.pdf> <b.pdf> ... -o out.pdf join files (form fields are kept) washi pdf from-images <a.jpg> <b.png> ... [--page a4|letter|image] [--margin pt] [--dpi 150] -o out.pdf photos and scans into pages (JPEG kept as it is) washi pdf split <in.pdf> [--pages 1-3,5|each] [-o dir] washi pdf organize <in.pdf> [--pages 3,1-2,5] [--rotate 2:90,5:-90] -o out.pdf reorder, drop (leave out) and turn pages (form fields are kept) washi pdf crop <in.pdf> (--margins top,right,bottom,left | --trim [--padding 6]) [--pages 1-3] [-o out.pdf] cut margins (points) or trim to the content washi pdf export-images <in.pdf> [--format png|jpeg] [--dpi 150] [--pages 1-3] [--quality 90] [-o folder] pages as image files washi ocr <in.pdf> [-o out.pdf] [--engine auto|vision|tesseract|ai] [--lang ja,en] [--pages 1-3] [--force] [--text out.txt] [--yes] make scanned pages searchable (an invisible text layer; the page image is unchanged) washi pdf erase <in.pdf> --box page:x0,y0,x1,y1 [--box ...] [-o out.pdf] [--all-ink] [--rules] remove printed text/images under boxes for real (points, top-left origin; coloured form printing stays) washi pdf protect <in.pdf> -o out.pdf [--open] [--allow print,copy,edit,comment,fill,assemble|none] add a password to open (--open) and/or limits (--allow: what stays allowed), AES-256; passwords are asked for, or read from WASHI_OPEN_PASSWORD / WASHI_PERMISSIONS_PASSWORD washi pdf unlock <in.pdf> -o out.pdf remove the password (asked for, or WASHI_PASSWORD) washi pdf clean <in.pdf> [--list] [--only metadata,attachments,scripts,comments,private] [-o out.pdf] remove hidden information (--list only shows it) washi pdf redact <in.pdf> [--find word ...] [--pattern email,phone,number] [--regex RE] [--box page:x0,y0,x1,y1] [--case] [--whole-words] [--list] [-o out.pdf] remove words, personal data or areas for real and cover them in black (--list only shows the matches) washi pdf find <in.pdf> <text> [--case] [--whole-words] where the text is, page by page washi pdf links <in.pdf> [--find-addresses] [--add page:x0,y0,x1,y1=target ...] [--remove 1-2,3-1] [-o out.pdf] list links, or add (web/mail address, page number) and remove them washi pdf images <in.pdf> [--add page:x0,y0,x1,y1=photo.jpg ...] [--replace 1-2=logo.png ...] [--remove 3-1] [-o out.pdf] list, add, replace or remove the images on the pages washi pdf compare <old.pdf> <new.pdf> [-o marked.pdf] what changed: words, pages, pictures (-o: the new version with each change marked) washi pdf replace-text <in.pdf> (--find old | --box page:x0,y0,x1,y1) --with new [--page n] [--ignore-case] [--whole-words] [-o out.pdf] change text on the page (one line at a time; checked before it is kept) --paragraph "text in it" --with "new paragraph": set the whole paragraph again in its width washi pdf stamp <in.pdf> [--header "left|center|right"] [--footer "…"] [--size 9] [--pages 1-3] [--bates PREFIX [--bates-start 1] [--bates-digits 6]] [--watermark TEXT [--opacity 0.3] [--angle 45] [--behind]] [-o out.pdf] headers, footers, page and Bates numbers ({page} {pages} {date} {file} {bates}), a watermark --replace-existing: take out what Washi added before; washi pdf stamp <in.pdf> --remove headers|watermarks|all [-o out.pdf]: only take it out washi pdf bookmarks <in.pdf> [--set outline.txt | --clear] [-o out.pdf] list the bookmarks (one per line: two spaces per level, a tab, the page), or write a copy with the ones in a file of that form washi pdf print <in.pdf> [--printer name] [--copies n] [--pages 1-3,5] [--two-sided] [--gray] [--actual-size] washi pdf printers list the printers washi pdf compress <in.pdf> [--level light|standard|strong] [-o out.pdf] a smaller copy (pages compared before it is kept) washi pdf sign <in.pdf> --id id.p12 [--field name | --page n --box x0,y0,x1,y1] [--reason …] [--location …] [--tsa URL] [-o out.pdf] sign with a digital ID (password from WASHI_ID_PASSWORD or asked for) washi pdf verify <in.pdf> check the signatures in a file washi pdf make-id --name "…" [--email …] -o id.p12 make a self-signed digital ID
